reconstructed_captions.13: As it descends, the helicopter's rotor wash kicks up a massive cloud of snow from the ground.
reconstructed_captions.14: The helicopter is almost completely obscured by the swirling snow as it nears the ground for landing.
reconstructed_captions.15: The helicopter touches down in a whiteout of snow kicked up by its powerful rotors.
reconstructed_captions.16: As the snow cloud begins to settle, the landed helicopter becomes visible on the ground.
reconstructed_captions.17: The rear ramp of the helicopter lowers onto the snowy ground.
reconstructed_captions.18: Soldiers in winter camouflage begin to disembark from the helicopter.
reconstructed_captions.19: The soldiers move quickly down the ramp and out into the snowy environment.
reconstructed_captions.20: More soldiers exit the helicopter, carrying rifles and large packs.
reconstructed_captions.21: The troops move away from the landed helicopter to secure the landing zone.
